verdict.rationale: Fellow documents recording with a visible bot, which is a form of in-meeting disclosure, and organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded. Neither is described as a consent or notification mechanism, and the same docs promote bot-less desktop capture. There is no evidence that admins can require the visible bot. missing for 10: participant consent notifications (pre-meeting or email), in-meeting disclosure announcement or banner, admin-enforced mandatory disclosure (e.g., blocking bot-less recording), consent-specific docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF

citations.quote: Fellow gives teams the flexibility to record with a visible bot or without one
Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained
